text:
```yaml
name: Infisical Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Fetch Infisical secrets
        uses: infisical/infisical-action@v1
        with:
          project-id: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID }}
          environment: 'development'
          token: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
```
